title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru

claims.claim: Starbucks CEO'su Brian Niccol, Perşembe günkü kazanç çağrısında şirketin kişiselleştirilmiş dijital menüler gibi deneyimleri keşfedeceğini belirtti.

evidence.quote: During an earnings call on Thursday, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore “experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless,” as spotted earlier by More Perfect Union.

During an earnings call on Thursday, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore “experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless,”

claims.claim: Starbucks, baristaların siparişleri daha doğru ve verimli girmesine yardımcı olmak için 2027'den itibaren arabaya servis noktalarında arka plan yapay zeka modellerini test etmeye başlayacak.

evidence.quote: Starting in 2027, Starbucks will also begin testing background AI models at the drive-thru to help baristas “input orders more accurately and efficiently,” according to Niccol.

claims.claim: Starbucks, müşterilerin ChatGPT üzerinden sipariş vermesine halihazırda izin vermeye başladı.

evidence.quote: Starbucks has already started allowing customers to place orders through ChatGPT

claims.claim: Starbucks, çalışanların tarifler ve hizmet standartları hakkında sorular sorması için yapay zeka destekli Green Dot Assist'i kullanıma sundu.

evidence.quote: and also rolled out an AI-powered Green Dot Assist that employees can use to ask questions about things like recipes and service standards.

Starbucks has already started allowing customers to place orders through ChatGPT, and also rolled out an AI-powered Green Dot Assist that employees can use to ask questions about things like recipes and service standards.
